verdict.rationale: Whether a SaaS data platform publishes its source under an open license is a fair axis, but nothing in the evidence shows Hightouch releasing its source under any license. The pack covers a proprietary hosted service with REST APIs, SDKs, an OpenAPI spec and an MCP server, none of which is open source code. The only license mention in the pack concerns RudderStack's license, not Hightouch's.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
